input: Call grandma for her birthday this Sunday

gold.taskTitle: Call Grandma for Her Birthday This Sunday
gold.taskDescription: Place a birthday phone call to grandma this coming Sunday.

questions.title: What time of day works best to call her?
questions.description: Identify the ideal time slot on Sunday to make the call.

questions.title: Do you have her current phone number saved?
questions.description: Confirm whether the correct contact information is already on hand.

questions.title: How long do you want the call to last?
questions.description: Set an expected duration so the user can plan their Sunday accordingly.

questions.title: Will you be calling from your phone or video calling?
questions.description: Determine the medium of communication — voice call, FaceTime, Zoom, etc.

questions.title: Do you need a reminder set before the call?
questions.description: Decide whether a prior notification is needed to avoid forgetting.

questions.title: Are you planning to say anything special or prepared?
questions.description: Find out if the user wants to prepare a message, song, or meaningful words.

questions.title: Is anyone else joining the call with you?
questions.description: Clarify whether this is a solo call or if other family members will participate.
